channel.title: SquirrelJME
channel.description: SquirrelJME is a Java ME 8 Virtual Machine.

item.title: February Update
item.description: Hi! This month was pretty productive! There were a few bug fixes around buffers, and DataInputStream.readUTF() being completely incorrect... oops! One of the major things is the forced serialization of ScritchUI pencil drawing operations, which fixes a large number of graphical glitches, freezes, and crashes due to changes in how modern hardware works. Other than that, I have been progressing rather nicely with NanoCoat which has been very nice.

item.title: SpringCoat Performance Improvements
item.description: I have not done much this month as my break continues, however I have been slowly getting back into the flow of things. There have been major improvements to SpringCoat performance around strings and DoJa application start times have been reduced greatly if you are using standalone. On the otherwise for NanoCoat, work continues on code execution!

item.title: Quite a year!
item.description: This year has been quite the year! In the current month of December I have mostly been making minor bug fixes and other small improvements around many miscellaneous areas, along with working on the macOS Cocoa UI.

item.title: An Anti-Burnout Break is Needed
item.description: The year has been exciting and so much has been done, but I also recognize that I need a much-needed break.
